questions.question_text:
A number rounds to $6.2$ (one decimal place) and has two decimal places.
What is the **largest** value it could have been?

options.why: $6.25$ rounds up to $6.3$, so it cannot round to $6.2$.
This rounds to $6.2$, but larger values such as $6.24$ also round to $6.2$.
This is the smallest value with two decimal places that rounds to $6.2$, not the largest.

questions.solution_text:
The largest value has tenths digit $2$.
Its hundredths digit can be at most $4$ without rounding up.
Largest value: $6.24$.
Check: $6.24$ rounds to $6.2$, but $6.25$ rounds to $6.3$.
